about: StoneRoadMap kit textures in colour (rusty-riders #10761, 2026-11-12), after Patch dropped level palettes. Generated on a Strix Halo ComfyUI with Z-Image base bf16 and the house LoRA rrink_zimage_v5_seg6_3000 at 1.0, SeamlessTileModelDiT + MakeCircularVAEDiT (tiles as generated, no seam repaint), 25 steps res_multistep cfg 4 shift 3, 1024x1024. Albedo is the generated image as RGBA; the normal map is scripts/texture-gen/make_tileable.py's normal_map at strength 3. Filtered with checks.py (floor-1 perspective; trim-1 gradient and perspective; trim-2 seam and perspective), then judged by two Sonnet orders per surface. In use: wall-6 (walls, 4 m), floor-6 (floors, 4 m), trim-3 (ceilings and trims, 2.5 m).
